prompt:
Subject: Disease disseminated through several body regions.

Composition: Show one neutral educational body silhouette containing simplified lungs, liver, and lymph nodes, with matching small purple disease foci scattered across these separate locations. Keep the distribution within one body clear and non-graphic, with no arrows implying a particular route or named diagnosis.

Style: Use the attached invidious.png for drawing style only. Match its thick rounded dark-brown contours, simplified rounded shapes, and restrained 2D cartoon shading. Do not copy the reference subject or composition.

Framing: One compact composition, with the complete subject using about 80-90% of the square. Keep all limbs and object tips inside the frame.

Output: 512x512 PNG, RGBA, genuine transparent background and transparent gaps. No text, speech balloons, explanatory captions, numerals, labels, logos or watermark.
en: A neutral body silhouette shows small purple disease foci scattered among the lungs, liver, and lymph nodes.
ja: 中立的な人体シルエットの肺・肝臓・リンパ節の複数箇所に、小さな紫色の病変を示す。
